note.text: Take the class tutorial at Temple Row: it hands out the Beginner Licenses
detail: Renown is 2 to 3: Specialty (Renown 4) isn't open, so everyone fights Ch 5 in a Beginner class.

buy.text: Buy a [[item:Javelin]] and a [[item:Hand Axe]] so you can counter at range

recruits.action: Pay 800G the day Renown 3 lands: cheap, early and mounted, which this army lacks
detail: Not Renown 3 by 4/30: recruit him in the first days of Ch 6. No deadline is known.

route.note: Take the 150 Renown now: it gets Io's Renown 3 in time

explore.text: [[place:Rubess Forest]] (Lv 9): Healing Staff for Yang Jie, Riding Manual, Lucky Coin
[[place:Nowah's Cave]] (Lv 10): Pure Water (one for Kiroc), Tactics Manual, Luxury Vegetable Crate
detail: Also a Turmoil Mask with no user: Fabio keeps his head slot empty.
Elektra, south-southeast of Dagsion: Amalthea, East Amalthea Posthouse, then Feronia Posthouse. Optional.
The Killing Edge +3 some lists put here is a Part III chest.

explore.text: [[place:Corroios Fort Ruins]] (Lv 13): Magic Staff for Fabio, Tactics Manual, Poisonbane Chain
detail: You come back here for Sepente in Ch 6.

battle.title: Shadowy Cave: Hannibal's Trial
battle.objective: Pull every lever, then defeat Hannibal
battle.lose: Dietrich falls, or 10 turns pass before the levers are done

tips.text: The Myrmidons can't be hurt until every lever is pulled
Send Io and Yang Jie left to the far switch, Dietrich and Fabio right; Mikaela and Esmeralda bait
detail: No Io yet (Renown 3 not reached): Mikaela goes left with Yang Jie, and Esmeralda baits alone.

tips.text: Ignore the Elephant Riders until the switches are done; killing them afterwards weakens Hannibal

loot.text: Chests: 2 Coins, [[item:Killing Edge]], White-Magic Manual (Yang Jie), Black-Magic Manual (Fabio)
detail: The only Part I Killing Edge chest: keep it for Dietrich, or hand it to A Sword of Deadly Renown (Ch 7).

exitExtra.text: Beat Borges and recruit Io, or keep 800G ready for the day Renown 3 lands
